title: Configuring a Zero Trust Browser Posture Profile

blocks.text: You can create a Zero Trust Browser Profile in the Zscaler Admin Console to verify whether incoming traffic originates from Zero Trust Browser—either the Enterprise Browser or Browser Extension. To learn more, see Understanding Enterprise Browser and Understanding Browser Extension.

You can then select and apply the posture profile when configuring isolation policy rules in Private Access (ZPA) to control application access based on whether the user is connecting via Zero Trust Browser. To learn more, see Configuring Isolation Policies.
Before configuring a Zero Trust Browser Posture Profile, you must configure a Device Posture Profile in Zscaler Client Connector with the following specifications:
To learn more, see Configuring Device Posture Profiles.

blocks.heading: Configuring a Zero Trust Browser Posture Profile

blocks.text: To configure a Zero Trust Browser posture profile:

blocks.item: From the navigation menu, go to Zero Trust Browser > Browser Isolation Private Apps > Browser Posture Profiles.
The Add Posture Profile drawer opens.
In the Add Posture Profile drawer:
Profile Name: Enter a name for the posture profile.
Device Posture: Select the device posture that you created previously.

blocks.text: The posture profile is added to the Zero Trust Browser Posture Profiles page.
